evidence.title: Phone input number component with Shadcn UI

name: Phone input number component with Shadcn UI
summary: Post and StackBlitz demo for building a custom phone number input with shadcn/ui and libphonenumber-js.
description: A blog post (2024-03-08) walking through a custom phone number input component built with shadcn/ui, plus the extra packages it needs (libphonenumber-js, react-phone-number-input) and how to register the locales you want. The interactive demo lives in a StackBlitz project pinned to the article-era stack; the code is linked on GitHub.
contains: StackBlitz demo pinned to the article-era stack
